ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: I selected Plover because this is a benign reasoning question where the only differentiator is raw capability. Plover's benchmark and internal eval scores are consistently and meaningfully higher than Whimbrel's (e.g., GPQA Diamond 64.1 vs 54.3, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4), and the task-preference profiles—which only diverge on harm-adjacent content—don't apply to a simple physics question. So the higher-capability model wins by default.
